run_59.trigger: SPS external scintillator coincidence via TCM

detectors.name: EIC_uRWELL_front
detectors.description: EIC uRWELL front reference (z=0, first the beam sees). FEU Id 68 (cfg Feu 1), Dream conn 1-4: x1/x2=ch1/2, y1/y2=ch3/4.

detectors.name: P2_IN
detectors.description: P2 telescope IN, upstream P2 (z=320 mm). det2 in bulking order. FEU Id 101 (cfg Feu 3).

detectors.name: P2_MID
detectors.description: P2 telescope MID (z=630 mm). det1 in bulking order. FEU Id 102 (cfg Feu 4).

detectors.name: P2_OUT
detectors.description: P2 telescope OUT, downstream P2 (z=940 mm). det3 in bulking order. FEU Id 103 (cfg Feu 5).

detectors.name: EIC_uRWELL_back
detectors.description: EIC uRWELL back reference (z=1370 mm, last the beam sees). FEU Id 68 (cfg Feu 1), Dream conn 5-8: x1/x2=ch5/6, y1/y2=ch7/8.

detectors.name: mx17_E
detectors.description: MX17 det4 ("Detector E"), the n_TOF group's chamber, z=1155 mm (PLACEHOLDER) between P2_OUT and the back uRWELL. FEU Id 101 (cfg Feu 3): X3-X6 = Dream 0-3, Y3-Y6 = Dream 4-7. Instrumented window is detector-local 99.8-298.7 mm in both views.
